name: Michelle Alva
reason: Strict health rule: her home page sells the ALVA Method as releasing trauma and producing 'deep and profound healing' under the banner 'Love Is Medicine', her Work With Me page pitches pain release and optimal health, her Linktree sells sessions on processing chronic stress plus a pregnancy series, and her Insight Timer tracks include weight-loss, anxiety and chronic-pain titles, so a listing would send people to condition-led pages (her tantra and intimacy workshops might pass on their own); she also has no published personal email, only a call-booking page with a support address.
